Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649962 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649962. Do not deduplicate rows. Return all matching activity rows.
